heading: Organize your bookmarks
intro: Analyze page content with your chosen AI provider, then review names and folders before exporting.
import_new_help: Each import starts a new project, even for the same file. Previous results stay saved separately.
empty: Import your browser bookmarks to get started.
new_region: New root folder: 整理済み
cancel_help: Cancel ends processing. Original bookmarks and saved results are kept.
cancelled_help: This job was cancelled and cannot be resumed. Select a scope to start a new analysis.
invalid_job_action: This action is unavailable in the current job state. Start a new analysis if the job was cancelled.
allow_incomplete: Explicitly keep unanalyzed items in 要確認 (Needs review)
review_intro: Review suggested names and locations. Changes are saved as new versions.
export_scope_help: Changed blocks includes bookmarks from every saved organization round, including failed items, with their parent folders. Unprocessed bookmarks are excluded.
integrity_ok: Verified: IDs, count, URLs and unselected content preserved.
model_help: Choose providers independently. Codex is available for content analysis; use LM Studio, Ollama or OpenRouter for embeddings.
distance_threshold: Similarity threshold for related-item ordering (also classification in older jobs)
rendering: Enable isolated JavaScript page retrieval (requires Chromium)
invalid_import: Cannot interpret this bookmark HTML without losing items. Import UTF-8 Netscape bookmark HTML.
invalid_scope: Select folders and choose a destination within the normalized selection.
job_conflict: This project already has an active job. Resume, finish or cancel it first.
job_incomplete: Finish or resume processing before creating a proposal.
analysis_incomplete: Some items were not analyzed. Retry, or explicitly allow keeping them in 要確認.
integrity_failed: Export blocked: preservation checks failed. Recreate or correct the proposal.
model_connection: Cannot reach the model API. Check the provider, connection and Settings, then retry.
model_unavailable: The chosen model is unavailable or does not support the required role. Discover models in Settings and select one.
analysis_invalid: The model returned invalid or truncated structured output. Retry or choose another model.
embedding_invalid: Embedding vectors are invalid or incompatible. Check the embedding model.
memory_budget: This selection exceeds the 128 MiB clustering budget. Process fewer folders.
restricted: Private or restricted destination held without fetching
csrf_failed: Reload this page and try again.
worker_error: Processing paused after an unexpected error. Resume to retry.
unknown_error: The operation failed. Reload or retry.
inference_help: Runtime uses the model defaults exposed by its API. App mode overrides the controls below; unchecked sampling controls are disabled. Separate runtime chat settings may not apply to API calls.
openrouter_help: OpenRouter uses an OpenAI-compatible cloud API. Content analysis sends bookmark URLs, names and retrieved page content; cloud embeddings send titles and analysis text to OpenRouter and its model providers. Usage may incur charges. Only supported model controls are sent; some models require thinking.
openrouter_key_help: Enter a key, or set OPENROUTER_API_KEY on the server. Save to keep the key for new and resumed jobs. Model discovery alone does not run inference.
openrouter_key_saved: A key is configured. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement. It is stored separately from job history.
openrouter_key_required: Enter an OpenRouter API key in Settings, then save or discover models.
openrouter_auth: OpenRouter rejected the API key or access. Check the key and account permissions.
openrouter_credits: OpenRouter credits are insufficient. Add credits or choose another model.
openrouter_rate_limit: OpenRouter rate limit reached. Wait, then retry manually.
openrouter_parameter: OpenRouter supports repetition penalty up to 2. Reduce the value in Settings.
model_input_help: Type the exact model ID or pick a suggestion. Typing filters the dropdown; discovery preserves your input.
organization_rules: Current preset: naming and folder rules
naming_rule: Names support search: use a specific purpose first, followed by ｜ and the site, tool or resource name. Japanese examples: 文章を翻訳｜DeepL and 画像の背景を削除｜remove.bg. Preserve proper names and avoid vague labels such as useful, recommended or other.
page_naming_rule: Distinguish whole sites from individual pages. Use Pythonの仕様を調べる｜Python Docs for a documentation home page and 正規表現の書き方を確認｜Python re for a specific feature. Name articles by topic, Q&A by the problem and solution, and product pages by the product and evaluation purpose.
github_naming_rule: For GitHub, use purpose｜repository［type or technology when needed］. Examples: 動画をダウンロード｜yt-dlp［CLI］ and HTTP通信を実装｜HTTPX［Python］. Distinguish apps, libraries, examples and curated lists by their use; add a suffix only when it helps identify them.
folder_rule: Folders support browsing: classify by the task for which you would open the page. Suggested areas are AI and machine learning, images and video, development, files and documents, research and learning, macOS and system, and everyday life and shopping. Keep official sites, GitHub repositories and articles with the same purpose together. Original names and locations help resolve ambiguity.
folder_growth_rule: Create only needed folders, with at most two levels below the destination. Create a subfolder only when its purpose has at least three items and the parent contains other items; merge smaller groups into the parent. Put uncertain purposes temporarily in あとで整理 and review them regularly. Avoid stuffing folder classifications into bookmark names.
rules_new_jobs: This preset applies to new analyses. Choose Custom instructions below to change either rule. Existing jobs and proposals retain their saved rules. Retrieval failures keep their names from the starting version and dedicated failure folders.
codex_help: Content analysis uses gpt-6-luna with medium reasoning through your ChatGPT plan. Bookmark URLs, names and retrieved page content are sent to OpenAI and consume your plan allowance. Embeddings use the separately selected provider.
codex_login_help: Install Codex CLI and run codex login on the machine running this app, choosing ChatGPT sign-in. No API key is used. The model and reasoning are fixed; sampling and output token controls do not apply. Discover models checks login and the catalog; model access is confirmed only by successful analysis.
codex_missing: Codex CLI could not start. Install Codex CLI and ensure codex is on the app server PATH.
codex_login_required: Codex requires ChatGPT sign-in. Run codex login on the app server and choose ChatGPT, then retry. API-key login is not accepted.
codex_failed: Codex could not complete analysis. Check CLI compatibility, connection and access to gpt-6-luna, then retry manually.
codex_limit: Your ChatGPT/Codex usage limit was reached. Wait for the allowance to reset, then retry manually.
codex_timeout: Codex exceeded the model response wait. Increase the limit or use 0 for unlimited, then retry manually.
preset_purpose: Current rules: purpose-based names and folders
rule_help: Choose Preset or Custom instructions separately for naming and folder grouping. Only the custom field is applied; a blank custom field uses its preset. Folder paths have at most two levels below the destination.
naming_placeholder: Example: Put the service name first, followed by a short description. Use English names.
folder_placeholder: Example: Group bookmarks into JS libraries, Python, and Utilities. Keep library names as subfolders.
rule_snapshot_help: Instructions are saved with each analysis. Changes apply to the next analysis; resume and retry keep the saved instructions.
continuation_ready: The folder tree includes your saved results. The next analysis starts from this version.
continuation_help: The proposal and each edit are saved automatically. Choose another folder and change the instructions to continue. Unselected bookmarks keep their saved names and locations; the export includes all saved rounds.
stale_proposal: A newer result has been saved. Reload the page to continue from the latest version.
job_already_proposed: This analysis already has a saved proposal. Start a new analysis to process these bookmarks again.
pending_proposal: A newer analysis has finished. Create its proposal before editing the previous result.
preset_naming: Preset: purpose｜site, tool or resource name
shutdown_help: Stop the application server. Running jobs will be paused and saved progress will be kept.
server_stopping: The server is stopping. New changes cannot be submitted.
server_stopped_help: Saved results have been kept. Interrupted jobs are paused and can be resumed after restarting the app. You can close this tab.
server_restart_help: To start the app again, run this command from the project folder:
server_shutdown_unavailable: Use the bookmark-organization startup command to enable server shutdown from the app.
